Introduction
This 
 document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed 
 every 1500 operating hours as indicated by H1500 in the title block.
The pump function is provided with the boilers required fuel and with required 
 pressure.
Technical Specification :
The first draft initiated by eng. Saied Eid & eng. Mohamed Saad Younes, reviewed & tested by eng. 
 Ahmed Fakhr El-Deen, accepted by eng. Abdel Fatah Mohamed Shehata, approved 
 by eng. Abdel Mohsen Abdel Ghafar: Head Sector of Kafr Eldawar Power Station.
This document certified by eng. Mona Ahmed Al Sharqawy: head sector of 
 inspection and quality control head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding 
 the work area is required.

Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tools set.
Cleaning fluid, Grease gun
Alignment device, Turbo oil 32
Work to be Carried Out
Main Cooling Pump
Uncouple the motor from the pump by removing the coupling bolts.
Check and record the alignment and the axial clearance.
Drain the oil from guide bearing.
Inspect and clean the oil cooler.
Inspect and repack the gland with new packing if required.
Inspect and clean the cooling water tubes.
Inspect the butterfly valve
Realign the motor to the pump.
Adjust the axial clearance.
Reconnect the coupling bolts.
